## Source: amazon-inspector (3fd53cc46174e799bbe5340512eb53aa19d00168034876b49d53671f90b15b83)
Package dictanovaasr version 0.1.0 was examined and no evidence of exfiltration, install-time or import-time code execution from external sources, silent relay, credential harvesting, backdoor, or self-propagation was identified. No install-time network activity, no suspicious lifecycle hooks, and no reads of installer-side credential paths (such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, or environment-variable scraping) were observed.

## Source: kam193 (afc8d83a420096900bdccd11b4ed6f45011c624cbc47c25a486576418203f4dd)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
